set.body: Outcome: user authorized next steps 1-4: clean local commit of qualified implementation, larger coverage investigation separating replicate noise from systematic error, measured runtime and memory, and named target contrast intervals computed per bootstrap replicate. Non-goals: publication, generic T/F, null p-values, adaptive rank. Preserve concurrent NIfTI work. Work in /private/tmp/scalafim-rrg-final-check with scoped commits. Evidence: independent fixture parity, paired simulation rows and uncertainty, resource receipt, both JVM and JS checks, downstream integration if concurrent migration settles.
